newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks seen up, finance results discounted.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks seen up, finance results discounted.

text.p: Thai stocks were expected to keep rising on Wednesday as investors have already discounted poor half-year earnings from finance companies, brokers said.

"Many banks and finance firms are expected to announce their half-year earnings results today. The index is expected to rise amid profit-taking of some finance stocks which had poor earnings. Most investors have discounted finance earnings results," said Padermpob Songkroh of Nava Finance.
The SET Index closed 6.41 points higher at 659.78 on 5.47 billion baht turnover on Tuesday. The SET-50 index added 0.59 point to 49.97. -- Suthep Chawla (662) 652-0642
